name: ASN, ISP and hosting type
plain: The IP maps to an ISP or hosting company, which tells if the visitor is a home, mobile or cloud user.
meaning: ASN databases label IPs as residential, mobile, business, hosting or education. Datacenter ASNs (AWS, GCP, OVH) trigger bot and fraud rules. Residential proxies are harder to spot.

web.api: BGP origin ASN lookup; IPinfo or MaxMind ASN and Anonymous IP databases

limits.headline: Can tell which internet company you use and if you look like a home user
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when your device connects to the site
can: Look up your network owner from your IP address, such as a home ISP, mobile carrier or school
Label the connection as home, mobile, business or data center
Raise bot or fraud checks when it looks like a cloud server
cannot: Learn your name or account from it
Pinpoint your home; it shows the network, not the house
Always catch residential proxies, which look like home users

story.what_it_is: Your internet address reveals whether you are on a home, phone or cloud network.
story.for_you: You never see this. Sites can tell if you are on a home internet plan, a mobile carrier, a school, a company or a cloud server. A VPN shows up as a hosting company.
story.for_makers: Fraud, ad and bot teams treat cloud and hosting addresses as higher risk. Streaming and gaming sites use it to spot VPNs and proxies, and ads use it to guess business or home.

use_cases.example: A game site blocks or flags accounts that come from cloud server addresses, which are common for bots.
A cloud gaming service checks that your network looks like home or mobile before it routes you to a nearby server.
A streaming service blocks known VPN hosting networks to enforce regional rights.
A ticket site slows down visitors from datacenters to stop scalper bots.
An ad network spots data center traffic and does not bill for it.
A bank adds risk when a login suddenly comes from a hosting provider.

technical_bounds: Labels lag behind IP leasing changes
Residential proxy networks defeat hosting checks
